Über die Position
Du möchtest das Wachstum eines führenden FMCG-Unternehmens aktiv mitgestalten und übernimmst gerne Verantwortung für den kommerziellen Erfolg deiner Kunden? Du baust langfristige Partnerschaften auf, führst strategische Verhandlungen und erkennst Chancen, bevor andere sie sehen?
Dann bist du bei der Flora Food Group genau richtig.
Als (Senior) Key Account Manager (m/w/d) übernimmst du die ganzheitliche Verantwortung für ein Portfolio strategischer Kunden und treibst nachhaltiges Wachstum in Bezug auf Umsatz, Profitabilität und Marktanteile voran. Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit deinen Kunden langfristige Wachstumsstrategien, setzt Joint Business Plans um und sorgst für eine exzellente Markt- und Kundenbearbeitung.
In dieser Rolle arbeitest du eng mit den Bereichen Sales, Marketing, Finance und Demand Planning zusammen und trägst maßgeblich zum Erfolg unserer Marken wie Rama, Becel, Lätta und Violife bei.
Deine Aufgaben
Kundenmanagement & Geschäftsentwicklung
Strategische Kundenbetreuung: Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung langfristiger Kundenbeziehungen sowie zentrale Ansprechperson für alle kommerziellen Themen im Traditional Trade und Discount-Bereich.
Geschäftsentwicklung : Entwicklung und Umsetzung gemeinsamer Wachstumsstrategien, Joint Business Plans sowie kundenindividueller Aktivierungs- und Innovationskonzepte zur Steigerung von Distribution, Umsatz und Profitabilität.
Umsatz-, Profitabilitäts- und Budgetverantwortung
Umsatz- & Profitabilitätsverantwortung: Verantwortung für Absatz-, NSV-, Marktanteils- und Profitabilitätsziele sowie Steuerung von Kundenbudgets, Handelsinvestitionen und Promotioninvestments.
Preis- & Vertragsverhandlungen: Eigenständige Führung von Jahres-, Preis- und Vertragsverhandlungen sowie Abschluss von Jahresvereinbarungen und langfristigen Geschäftsvereinbarungen.
Business Planning & Performance Management
Business Planning & Forecasting: Verantwortung für die rollierende Absatz-und Promotion Planung der betreuten Kunden sowie Sicherstellung einer hohen Forecast Accuracy in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Demand Planning.
Performance Management: Durchführung regelmäßiger Business Reviews sowie Identifikation und Umsetzung geeigneter Maßnahmen zur Erreichung der vereinbarten Geschäftsziele.
Zusammenarbeit, Reporting & Analyse
Cross-funktionale Zusammenarbeit: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Marketing, Finance und Demand Planning zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung der Kundenstrategie.
Reporting & Analyse: Analyse relevanter KPIs sowie Nutzung von Markt- und Kundendaten (z. B. NielsenIQ, Circana/GfK) zur Identifikation von Wachstumschancen und Risiken.
Was benötigst du, um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein?
FMCG- & Handelsexpertise: Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Key Account Management innerhalb der FMCG- oder Konsumgüterbranche sowie fundierte Kenntnisse der Handels- und Discountstrukturen im deutschsprachigen Markt .
Kommerzielles Know-how: Nachweisbare Erfolge in der Entwicklung von Großkunden sowie Erfahrung in der Führung von Jahres- und Preisverhandlungen, der Steuerung von Handelsinvestitionen und dem Management profitablen Wachstums.
Analytische Kompetenz: Sicherer Umgang mit Markt- und Kundendaten (z. B. NielsenIQ, Circana/GfK) . Klares Verständnis der Kunden PnL und der Steuerungsmechanismen. Sehr gute Excel-Kenntnisse zur Ableitung datenbasierter Entscheidungen.
Unternehmerisches Mindset: Hohe Eigeninitiative, ausgeprägte Ergebnisorientierung und die Fähigkeit, Wachstumschancen zu identifizieren und erfolgreich umzusetzen.
Kommunikations- & Stakeholder Management: Überzeugendes Auftreten, starke Verhandlungsfähigkeiten sowie die Fähigkeit, langfristige Kundenbeziehungen und cross-funktionale Zusammenarbeit erfolgreich zu gestalten.
Sprachen & Mobilität: Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sowie Reisebereitschaft innerhalb des betreuten Marktgebietes.

OneTrust is a fast-growing SaaS enterprise platform with a strong growth trajectory. We invest heavily in our Sales Team through demand generation, methodology-driven sales philosophy, weekly sales trainings, customer-driven roadmaps, and a readily-available executive team to help close deals.

CMF – Turning ideas into impact.
Wir sind eine Full-Service-Agentur und machen aus „How?" ein „Wow!" mit kreativer Strategie, innovativer Technologie und messbarem Impact. Wir vereinen alle Disziplinen unter einem Dach, ob digital oder analog, klassisch oder crazy, und entwickeln seit über 42 Jahren für namhafte Kunden wie Allianz, Coca-Cola, BMW, Nestlé und Rewe Kampagnen, die begeistern. Verstärke unser rund 100-köpfiges Team am Standort Oberursel als:
Senior Account Manager / Senior Kundenberater (m/w/d)
Aufgaben
Deine Mission
Dein Kunde kommt mit einer Idee, einem Thema, einem Problem, und du siehst sofort das ganze Bild: was das für Social Media bedeutet, was für Performance, was für Content, was für Print und vor allem den nächsten Vertriebstermin.
Du bist die Person, die aus einem Briefing ein funktionierendes Konzept macht, statt nur eine To-do-Liste abzuarbeiten.

Du führst deine Kunden und Projekte eigenständig, steuerst Kampagnen von der ersten Idee bis zur Ausspielung, behältst Budget, Timing und Qualität im Blick und übersetzt, was der Kunde eigentlich braucht, in Briefings, die alle internen Teams sofort verstehen und gerne umsetzen.

Dabei bist du Sparringspartner auf Augenhöhe und gibst Orientierung, auch wenn die Lösung noch nicht auf dem Tisch liegt. Schon bei der ersten Idee denkst du mit, statt nur abzuwarten, du bringst Trends und Chancen von dir aus ins Gespräch, bevor der Kunde danach fragt.

Genau das unterscheidet Beratung von Verwaltung, und genau darin siehst du auch Potenzial für den Etat, nicht nur für das nächste Projekt.
Qualifikation
Das bringst du mit
Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Client Service oder Account Management einer Agentur, idealerweise mit eigenständiger Verantwortung für Kunden und Etats – du kennst das Spiel zwischen Kundenwunsch, Machbarkeit und Kreativität und hast Lust darauf
Ein Kopf, der Themen automatisch kanalübergreifend denkt, von Social über Performance Marketing bis zur Klassik und Vertriebskommunikation, statt sie nacheinander abzuarbeiten
Verständnis für aktuelle Social-Media-Mechaniken und ein Gespür dafür, wie sich Formate und Trends gerade verschieben und wie man diese in andere Kanäle übertragen kann
Eine extrem strukturierte, selbstständige Arbeitsweise, du behältst auch bei fünf parallelen Projekten den Überblick und verlierst nie den Faden
Routine mit modernen PM-Tools zur Steuerung von Timings, Budgets und Kapazitäten
Sicheres Auftreten bei Präsentationen und Verhandlungen auch gegenüber anspruchsvollen Kunden: Du erklärst, ordnest ein und triffst Empfehlungen statt nur Wünsche weiterzureichen
Mit unternehmerischem Blick auf deine Projekte erkennst du, wo im Etat noch Potenzial steckt, und sprichst es aktiv an
Ein analytisches Grundverständnis für KPIs wie Reach, Engagement, ROAS und Conversion, um laufende Maßnahmen einzuordnen und weiterzuentwickeln
Freude an enger Zusammenarbeit mit allen internen Teams, du briefst so, dass sie gerne mit dir arbeiten, und gibst dein Wissen auch an weniger erfahrene Kollegen weiter
Neugier auf neue Tools und KI-gestützte Workflows, die dir mehr Zeit für Beratung statt Verwaltung verschaffen

Das bekommst du
Etats mit echter Gestaltungsfreiheit, kurze Entscheidungswege und die Möglichkeit, Kundenbeziehungen und Etats langfristig mitzuentwickeln. Ein Umfeld, in dem KI und neue Tools nicht diskutiert, sondern eingesetzt werden, plus Lern- und Weiterbildungsbudget für Konferenzen, Trainings und Tools.

Hybrides Arbeiten, flexible Zeiten, ein modernes, klimafreundliches Büro in Oberursel mit eigener Bar. Attraktive Vergütung, End-of-Year-Bonus, betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit bis zu 50 % Arbeitgeberzuschuss, vermögenswirksame Leistungen, 28 Tage Urlaub und Ausstattung, die mitdenkt: Laptop und Firmenhandy.

Dazu Team-Events, auf die man sich wirklich freut.

About Wolt
At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.
Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.
At Wolt, we create technology that brings local communities, merchants and customers closer together. What started with restaurant delivery has grown into a broader local commerce platform, helping customers discover and access more of what their cities have to offer.
As our Retail business continues to grow, we're looking for a Senior Sales Regional Enterprise Manager to expand our selection of high-value regional retail partners. You'll join our Enterprise Sales team and take ownership of some of the most important regional acquisition opportunities across priority retail verticals, helping shape what customers can find on Wolt in their cities. This role can be based in Berlin, Cologne or Frankfurt.
What you'll be doing
In this role, you'll own the acquisition and development of high-value regional Enterprise retail partners in Germany, from identifying and engaging the right prospects through commercial negotiations, signing and initial rollout. You'll combine strong commercial execution with a strategic view on which partners can have the greatest impact on Wolt's selection, coverage and long-term growth.

Own the end-to-end sales cycle for regional Enterprise retail opportunities, from prospecting and qualification through negotiation, contracting and signing.
Build and manage a high-quality pipeline of larger regional retailers and multi-location partners across priority verticals such as grocery, convenience, pet, pharmacy and beauty.
Develop a deep understanding of prospective partners' businesses and create compelling commercial propositions that demonstrate the value of partnering with Wolt.
Lead complex commercial negotiations, balancing partner needs with sustainable economics and Wolt's long-term business objectives.
Build strong relationships with senior decision-makers and act as a trusted commercial partner throughout the sales process.
Work closely with internal teams including Operations, Account Management, Finance, Legal, Marketing and Product to structure partnerships and enable successful launches.
Take ownership beyond the signature, ensuring a strong handover and initial rollout so that newly acquired partners can successfully go live and scale.
Use market insights, pipeline data and commercial learnings to identify opportunities, prioritize the highest-impact accounts and continuously improve our regional Enterprise sales approach.
Contribute to sharing best practices and raising the bar for Enterprise sales execution across the wider team.
Our humble expectations
You have significant experience in B2B sales, business development or strategic partnerships, ideally working with Enterprise or other complex, multi-stakeholder customers.
You have a strong track record of independently managing and closing complex commercial opportunities from initial outreach through contract signature.
You're an excellent negotiator and understand how to build partnerships that create sustainable value for both sides.
You're comfortable engaging and influencing senior stakeholders, both externally and across cross-functional internal teams.
You combine a hands-on, results-oriented sales mindset with strong commercial judgment and the ability to prioritize opportunities based on their strategic impact.
You're highly structured and comfortable managing multiple opportunities and stakeholders simultaneously while maintaining strong attention to detail.
You're comfortable working with data and commercial metrics to evaluate opportunities, build business cases and inform decisions.
You communicate clearly and persuasively and are fluent in English and German.

This is an opportunity to play a meaningful role in the next phase of Wolt's Retail growth. You'll have direct ownership of high-impact regional partnerships and the autonomy to take opportunities from first conversation all the way through to launch.
You'll work at the intersection of sales, strategy and operations, collaborating with experienced colleagues across Wolt while building relationships with some of the most important retailers in the market. The role offers substantial commercial ownership and exposure while giving you the opportunity to develop further in Enterprise sales and contribute to how we scale our Retail business.
You'll also join a fast-moving international environment where good ideas can quickly turn into action, with the tools, support and trust to take ownership of your work and make a visible impact.
Next steps
If this sounds like an opportunity you'd be excited about, we'd love to hear from you.
After you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application and get in touch with selected candidates for an initial conversation. The process will typically include interviews with the hiring team and relevant stakeholders, giving you the opportunity to learn more about the role, team and business while we get to know your experience and approach.
Depending on the role and location, the process may also include a practical case or commercial exercise. We'll share the exact interview steps and expectations with you as you progress through the process.
Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Job Description About ScholarshipOwl
ScholarshipOwl is the largest scholarship marketplace in the U.S. , connecting over 14 million Gen Z students with private scholarships — and the brands that power them. Our mission is to make education financing more accessible and engaging, while giving brands a way to connect with the next generation.
We’re powered by AI technology that simplifies scholarship discovery, streamlines the application process, and delivers measurable results for both students and partners. Whether it’s helping students secure funding or enabling brands to run impactful campaigns, we’re reshaping how education is funded — and discovered.

Reports to: Director of Sales
Compensation: Strong base salary + uncapped commission structure with clear accelerators for over-performance.
We are looking for a proactive, results-oriented Account Executive (Full Cycle) to take strong ownership of our revenue growth through consistent, targeted outbound prospecting and strategic closing. This is a high-impact, mid-to-senior level role designed for a true "hunter" who thrives on turning cold opportunities into high-quality, long-term B2B clients for our SSC and Pro product lines.
This role runs in two gears : sharp and disciplined in creating pipeline — targeted, creative outbound to a defined ICP, disciplined qualification, and efficiently filtering out deals that aren't a fit — and consultative once you're in the room, where discovery and product education come before the pitch and multi-stakeholder deals are won on understanding, not pressure.
In this role, you won't just wait for inbound leads—you will own the entire sales lifecycle . From dedicated outbound prospecting and strategic qualification to leading compelling product demos and closing complex deals, you will drive the pipeline that fuels our expansion. If you are motivated by building a robust book of business from scratch and find purpose in driving net-new revenue, you’ll thrive in this position.
What You'll Be Selling
Sponsored Scholarship Campaigns (SSC) — Our flagship product, and a performance marketing channel rather than a philanthropy program. It's built on the foundation of something Gen Z is already looking for: scholarships, not ads. The brand earns the next generation of customers, and students earn financial aid.

We build the campaign with the client and run the scholarship end to end, so the brand reaches a US Gen Z audience through a channel that's permission-based by design rather than interruptive, and generates first-party, opt-in insights at scale .
What that solves varies by client, and learning to read which version you're selling is a real part of the job: customer and user acquisition, lead generation, recruiting pipeline, content, or serious brand engagement with the next generation of buyers. Your buyer is typically a Growth Manager or marketing lead at a brand or agency that sells to Gen Z, and you're competing for performance marketing budget against paid social and search, not against other scholarship platforms.
ScholarshipOwl Pro — Scholarship management for organizations already running their own scholarship programs in cumbersome or inefficient ways: shorter cycle, more operational, philanthropic buyer , and a second motion alongside SSC.

Relentless Prospecting: Execute high-volume daily outbound campaigns (calls, emails, LinkedIn) to hunt for net-new opportunities and consistently book discovery meetings .
Full-Cycle Ownership: Run the entire sales process from initial cold outreach and aggressive qualification to running product demos, sending proposals, and closing deals .
Data-Driven Pipeline Triage: Actively manage your sales funnel within HubSpot, performing regular pipeline reviews to prioritize high-value opportunities and ruthlessly cut weak leads .
Drive Revenue & Velocity: Take absolute ownership of your targets, driving urgency in deal cycles to progress opportunities through late-stage negotiations and contract signing.
Hit Major Milestones: Our sales cycle runs four to six months, so your first quarter is about building. Deliver $175–300K in qualified pipeline (approx. 20–30 qualified meetings ) in your first 90 days , and close your first net-new deal within six months .
Iterate & Optimize: Continuously refine your outreach messaging and campaign targeting based on performance metrics to maximize conversion rates.

Must-Haves
3+ Years of B2B Sales Experience: A proven track record of exceeding quotas in a full-cycle B2B sales or business development role (prospecting through to close).
"Hunter" Mentality & Dialing Discipline: You have a high drive, resilience in the face of rejection, and a proven daily discipline for outbound cold calling .
Pipeline Mastery: Strong proficiency with HubSpot (or a comparable CRM) paired with immaculate data hygiene , accurate notes, and clear deal-stage tracking.
Exceptional Execution: Proven ability to run tight discovery calls , command proposal conversations, control the sales narrative, and push multi-stakeholder deals across the finish line .
Communication Excellence: Advanced English proficiency with exceptional presentation and relationship-building skills across phone, Zoom, email, and Slack.

Experience using advanced outbound workflows or AI-driven discovery tools like Clay .
Familiarity with mid-market sales cycles (4–6 months) involving multi-stakeholder decision-making.
A background working within high-growth startup or fast-paced SMB environments.
Nice-to-Haves
Educational Foundation: Holds a Bachelor’s degree (though we highly value proven sales grit and revenue results over formal education).
Targeted Industry Experience: Experience selling into Directors, CMOs, Growth, or Brand leaders —ideally within marketing, lead generation, digital acquisition, or performance models.
U.S. Market Exposure: Familiarity with U.S. business culture , the U.S. education/scholarship landscape, or holding a degree from a U.S.-based institution.
Strategic Traits: A natural curiosity to uncover deeper customer needs and the strategic thinking required to prioritize high-value enterprise or agency opportunities.

Mission-Driven Work: Build technology that helps students unlock education opportunities and reduce financial barriers.
Fully Remote: Work from anywhere in the world while collaborating with a global team. (Note: This role requires overlapping with standard U.S. working hours for client meetings).
High Impact & Ownership: You aren't just a cog in a machine; you own your domain and directly drive results.
Unlimited PTO: We value outcomes over hours worked and trust you to manage your time.

About Cytix
Software never stops changing. Teams ship new code every day, through tickets, pull requests, releases, and increasingly with AI in the mix, but the way security keeps up with all that change hasn't really moved on.
That's the problem we're solving. Cytix helps organisations understand which software changes actually matter, what should happen next, and how to prove the right call was made. Security understood, in other words.
We're a small team with big plans, so every person we hire genuinely shapes what Cytix becomes. That's why we're upfront about our five values: we interview for all of them, and they matter to us more than a perfect CV. They're things you do, not things you are, so have a read and see if they sound like you.
Make the first move . When the goal is clear but the path isn't, you get moving rather than waiting for perfect instructions. If you're blocked, you make a sensible call, say what you're assuming, and explain how you'd course-correct. We'd rather you act and be slightly wrong than sit still.
Find the smarter path. You ask why before how. You dig into what the real problem is instead of just building what the spec says, and you're happy to question 'that's how it's always been done' when the reason behind it has gone stale.
See it through. When something's yours, it lands. No loose ends, no surprises for whoever picks it up next. You keep people posted when things change, and if something falls between roles, you catch it.
Raise the bar. You do the best job possible in the time you've got, whether that's a day or a month. Sometimes that means deep craft; sometimes the smartest move is quick and scrappy. It's about good judgement, and we hold each other to it without blame or politics.
Play to win. You care about the mission but don't take yourself too seriously. You say 'I' when things go wrong and 'we' when they go right, trust teammates to do things their own way, and bring a bit of humour when the pressure's on.

Working under the direction of senior CSAMs and a Manager, the CSAM operates within a defined pod covering a shared portfolio of accounts. The role contributes to portfolio-level intelligence, execution orchestration, and reactive signal aggregation - reducing context-switching for senior CSAMs and accelerating customer outcomes.
This is a talent-engine role: CSAMs are AI-first, customer-facing from month three, and grow through structured cohorts and community.

## Executive partnership and execution ##
* Execute standardized executive partnership, solution health, cloud adoption, and AI acceleration tasks under direct guidance from senior CSAMs or CSU leaders.
* Support agent and Copilot adoption motions across assigned pod accounts.
* Complete assigned activities accurately and on time; escalate exceptions rather than independently diagnose them.
## Portfolio-level intelligence and preparation ##
* Maintain deep, current account context across the pod-s defined portfolio.
* Synthesize account signals into -what-s changed / what matters now-
* Detect risks, upcoming deliveries, upcoming milestones, and open threads.
* Detect portfolio patterns such as recurring blockers across multiple accounts.
## Execution orchestration (not delivery) ##
* Track delivery and milestone progress with partners and CSAs on behalf of senior CSAMs.
* Map dependencies across workloads and milestones.
* Proactively flag drift before the customer raises it.
* Coordinate remediation follow-ups across internal teams.
## Reactive signal aggregation ##
* Monitor reactive support signals - case volume, aging, repeat drivers - across the pod portfolio.
* Aggregate reactive trends into portfolio-level views and surface early warnings of escalation risk.
* Track follow-through on Support, IM, and Service Manager commitments; chase stalled internal owners.
* Distill reactive noise into CSAM-ready insights, not raw data.
## Operating model ##
* Operate within a pod model covering a shared portfolio of accounts.
* Work under direct oversight of the Manager and senior CSAMs assigned to the pod.
* Limit interactions to task execution and information capture; executive partnership and account governance is led by the senior CSAM.

* Legally authorised to work in the location where this role is based - Zurich, Switzerland (Legally authorised = you hold citizenship or have been granted a valid visa or work permit.) Relocation expenses are not provided as part of this role.
* Fluency in English must be mandatory
* Fluency in French AND/OR German is mandatory

* Coursework or experience in program management, business operations
* Exposure to enterprise software, cloud platforms, or B2B customer success.

Share what’s working and learn what’s not bringing a growth mindset to every deal, and adapt quickly when SOPs, experiments, or strategies evolve

Mission - Why we exist, what we do, and why we need you
Onomi is the HCP engagement and intelligence platform for life sciences. Pharma commercial and medical teams use Onomi to run their HCP engagements, congresses, webinars, advisory boards, and everyday meetings, and to capture what actually happens in them: every interaction captured with consent, matched to the right HCP record, and written back to Veeva or Salesforce in minutes, so the engagement they already pay for comes back as data their teams can act on.

This is Onomi's first dedicated business development role in the US, and you are not starting from zero.

We have a strong US account management and event services team on the ground, a US customer base of 100 referenceable pharma companies including AstraZeneca, Takeda, Sanofi, GSK, and BeOne, and over 500,000 HCPs engaged across our platform every month.

Our go-to-market is event-first: our leadership team speaks at the industry's events, usually with a booth alongside, and you will be there with them; at key conventions we prospect as participants, where our customers gather; our biweekly webinars hand you a warm, named audience after every session.

What has been missing are the people on the ground converting that presence and proof into new logos. We are hiring 3 talents at once as our founding US new-business group, working directly with the CEO, the leadership team, and senior sales colleagues in other regions.

[35%] Work industry events: build target lists from attendee data before each event, staff the booth at leadership's speaking events, prospect conventions as a participant (first alongside colleagues, then solo), and follow up with every named contact with relevant messaging.
[20%] Run personalized outbound to webinar audiences and industry event attendee lists, turning warm names into booked first meetings. No mass sequences; every message is yours and very specific.
[20%] Run first meetings: your three-slide story, sharp discovery questions, and a crisp follow-up that gets forwarded internally.
[25%] Progress opportunities with senior support: bring in a senior seller, our solutions team or our leadership team at the right moment, keep every deal moving in an open deal channel, and co-sell through scoping and close.

s.h: In your first month, you will
s.t:
Join our leadership team at live industry events: staff the booth at tradeshows and walk congresses with them.
Master our core sales plays: rehearse them, listen to past winning calls, and run mock first meetings that convince the team you can do it alone.
Start outbound on your first event attendee list and webinar audience, and book your first attended meetings.

s.h: In your first 3 months, you will
s.t:
Have 30+ attended first meetings on the board, with a 70%-plus show rate.
Staff your first medical convention solo, with a pre-event target list, a floor contact log, and 100% follow-up.
Convert each webinar cycle into at least 2 attended meetings.
Have your first opportunities in discovery with a senior co-seller attached.
By month 6, you will have closed your first new US logo, co-sold with a senior colleague (for which you will get 100% quota retirement), and earned a clear conversation about your lane: toward closing bigger deals or leading meeting generation as we scale the team.

s.h: What you need to be great at
s.t:
Speed and consistency despite ambiguity: following up same day, never dropping a ball, staying creative when the playbook runs out.
Curiosity about the product and the customer: you ask why a customer runs things the way they do, you go into the layers underneath.
Nobody expects you to become a sales engineer, but if your answer to every product question is 'let me loop someone in,' buyers lose interest and the someone loses patience.
In-person presence: you are at your best on a floor, at a booth, in a hallway conversation, and you want to travel to make that happen (expect to hop on a plane every 2-3 weeks).
Taking feedback fast: we coach constantly; what we correct on Monday shows up in your work on Tuesday.
Working with support rather than an army: you handle what you can and escalate deliberately.
Writing that sells: short, specific, personal messages that get replies.

s.h: What we are most curious about
s.t:
Tell us about events or trade shows you have worked on: what you did before, on, and after the floor, and what it produced, with real numbers.
Walk us through a product you sold and what sat underneath it: how it worked, why customers chose it, what its limits were.
What are 2 or 3 outreach tactics that reliably got you replies and meetings, and how did you know they worked?
Tell us about the last piece of feedback that changed how you work, and what changed.
